proposals.evidence: DEDR4004 gives Tamil/Malayalam paḻam ripe fruit, Irula pammu/pāmu, Toda pum, Kannada paṇṇu, Parji pal, Gondi paṇḍ(i) and Konda paṇḍu. Selected survey paḷam/payam/pagam/paśam/pām- responses preserve lect-specific reflexes or loss of the medial retroflex, and Kannada/related annu reflects loss of initial h-. These are comparative family proposals; the separate Indo-Aryan-looking phal forms and opaque responses are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3656 gives Tamil/Malayalam/Kota nāḷ day and Kannada nāḷ day/time. Selected southern survey nāḷ/naḷɨ/ṇāḷɨ retain this day stem; Mannan na is the proposed final-lateral-loss counterpart, qualified as a comparative lect extension. Longer temporal phrases are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3656 explicitly gives Tamil nāḷai/nāḷaikku, Malayalam nāḷa, Kannada nāḷe, Kodagu nāḷe/nāḷēkï, Gondi nāṛ(i) and Kurux nelā tomorrow. Selected survey forms preserve the day-stem temporal/locative endings, including nāḷɛykɨ and regional vowel/lateral variants; these are ordinary inflected temporal forms. proposals.evidence: DEDR4240 gives Tamil pukai, Malayalam puka, Kannada/Kodagu poge, Tulu pugè/pogè, Telugu poga and Gondi poya/poyo/poī smoke. Selected survey p-/h-/zero-initial and intervocalic k/g/h/y forms preserve that family; voga/voge have a glide onset following initial-consonant loss. Source vowel and consonant notation is retained, while opaque longer responses are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1391 explicitly gives Tamil kaṟi raw or boiled meat/vegetables and Malayalam kaṟi meats/vegetables/hot condiments. These southern survey kari meat responses select the meat sense of that culinary family, retaining the source non-retroflex rhotic spelling. Precise inter-lect transmission is not established by the widespread culinary term alone. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
